tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the tab bar, the scratch pad and answer options.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on bg and surface. Also the scratch pad pen and the floating scratch pad button.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Supporting text and inactive tab labels on bg or surface. About 5.4 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Decorative icons only, such as the chevron at the end of a row. Never for text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card, empty progress tracks and the scratch pad grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of answer options, route lines and empty schedule markers.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The one main action on a screen, progress fills, active navigation and correct answers. White text on it is about 6.2 to 1.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: End colour of the gradient on the repeats card. Not used on its own.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind green icons, the active tab, correct answers and the wash at the top of each screen.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Supporting text placed on green, including the lighter corner of the repeats card. About 4.6 to 1 at the lightest point of that card.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The current marker on the repeat schedule and the current segment of a progress strip. Never for text.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the streak and missed pills and of hints.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text on amber-soft. About 6.3 to 1.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Wrong answers, missed problems and weak topics. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind red icons and wrong answers.

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: A single headline number, such as days to the exam.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: The title of a screen and the title of the repeats card. One per screen, plus the card.

styles.name: problem-text
styles.sample: Find the height of the tower.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Let x be the distance from B to the tower.
styles.usage: Default text, answer options and solution steps.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: The name of a row, a button label.

styles.name: secondary
styles.usage: Supporting line under an item title, in ink-2.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small headings above a group, pills and segmented controls.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Schedule stops, chart axes and figures inside rings.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Labels in the phone tab bar and the tablet rail only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a pill; gap between progress segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between answer options and between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items inside a group; padding of a single-row card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside list rows and small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margin on a phone; gap between groups; padding of the repeats card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between columns on tablet and laptop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen margin on a tablet.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Screen margin on a laptop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Answer options, hints, feedback banners, segmented controls and sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The repeats card, the scratch pad and the floating navigation.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups resting on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar and the floating scratch pad button.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The scratch pad when it slides up as a sheet on a phone.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest height or width of anything that can be tapped.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, answer options and tab bar items.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon size. Stroke width is 1.75px.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Square icon tile at the start of a row.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: At this width and above: navigation becomes a left rail, Today and Subjects use two columns, the scratch pad sits beside the problem.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: At this width and above: navigation becomes a sidebar with full labels and margins widen.
